Suggest the next rendehR pipeline command

Source: R/pipeline.R
ehr_suggest_next.Rd

Inspects source-level outputs without running pipeline stages, then suggests the next command to run. The check is conservative: if a stage output cannot be validated, the stage is treated as incomplete.

Usage

ehr_suggest_next(
  src_names = NULL,
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  stages = NULL,
  target_schema = "rendehr",
  suggest_merge = TRUE,
  require_log = FALSE,
  run_external = FALSE,
  run_cohort_annotations = NULL,
  run_comorbidities = NULL,
  run_iss = NULL,
  raw_data_root = NULL
)

Arguments

src_names

Character vector of source names. If NULL, uses the active project config source, then "mimic_iv_demo".

db_name

Postgres database name. Defaults to the active project config, then "rendehr".

base_dir

Project root directory. Defaults to the active project config, then current working directory.

stages

Optional character vector of stage names to check. If NULL, checks all active stages for each source.

target_schema

Target schema to suggest for merge_sources() when all sources appear complete. Default "rendehr".

suggest_merge

Logical. If TRUE and multiple sources appear complete, suggest merge_sources() when merged outputs are missing. Default TRUE.

require_log

Logical. Passed to the stage validator. Default FALSE so existing outputs created before pipeline logging can still be recognized.

run_external

Logical. If TRUE, include external SQL concepts in stage checks and recommendations.

run_cohort_annotations

Logical. If TRUE, run build_cohort_annotations() to write the ICD classification lookup and cohort enrichment table. Default NULL resolves to FALSE because the generalized cohort path uses build_cohort_info_general().

run_comorbidities

Logical, or NULL (default). If NULL, mandatory only for the "scid" cohort profile (identical(paths$cohort_profile, "scid")) - opt-in for every other profile, matching run_iss. Pass TRUE/FALSE explicitly to override either way, regardless of profile. When run, computes Charlson and Elixhauser comorbidity indices and writes to {raw_schema}.comorbidities. Requires the comorbidity package. Skipped gracefully when skip_on_error = TRUE and the package is not installed.

run_iss

Logical, or NULL (default). If NULL, mandatory only for the "scid" cohort profile (identical(paths$cohort_profile, "scid")) - opt-in for every other profile. Pass TRUE/FALSE explicitly to override either way, regardless of profile. When run, computes the Injury Severity Score (ISS/NISS via icdpicr) and writes to {raw_schema}.iss. Requires the icdpicr package. Skipped gracefully when skip_on_error = TRUE and the package is not installed.

raw_data_root

Character string giving the parent directory of the raw source files. Files for a source are read from raw_data_root/src_name. If NULL, use the project configuration or data/source_data under base_dir.

Value

An object of class ehr_suggestion with status, recommended_code, and merge_status fields.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ehr_suggest_next(src_names = "mimic_iv_demo", db_name = "rendehr")
} # }
